verdict.rationale: Gumroad's own marketing says customers can pay in their own currency and creators can price in a currency of choice. It also pays creators by direct deposit or PayPal depending on country, which covers the local-currency charging and bank-settlement parts of the story. All of this is homepage and pricing-page claims, with no detail on how conversion works. Missing for 10: transparent FX handling (conversion rates, fees, timing), documentation of settlement currency to the creator's bank, depth beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: Let your customers pay in their own currency.
Choose between one-time, recurring, or fixed-length payments in your currency of choice.
How we pay creators, whether through direct deposit or PayPal, varies by country.
